title: Detailed armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='26' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#7a4a22'/>

  <rect x='66' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#7a4a22'/>
